sections.title: Chilean shrub
sections.text: Vestia foetida is an evergreen shrub endemic to central and southern Chile. In gardens it reaches roughly 1.5–2.5 m high and 1–1.5 m wide. Its narrow, glossy leaves have an unpleasant smell; pendent tubular yellow flowers are about 2.5–3 cm long, followed by a dry capsule.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: Do not treat it as an edible or medicinal plant: veterinary reports document fatal poisoning of cattle after they browsed the foliage, and research identifies hepatotoxic compounds in the species. The plate matches the yellow tubular flowers, narrow leaves and capsule.
